notes.title: Modding, New Port, and More!
notes.content:
Major update of 2023! This new version brings:

[list]
[*] Finished port: Hamburg
[*] Better ability to mod: import any ship of any model, and the game will detect, import, and let you sail it
[*] New ship editor v2: this is the tool to export your ship models from Blender / 3DSMax to the game
[*] Added: mod manager - let’s you configure the X Y Z position of the imported ship
[*] Stability fixes on the autopilot, radar, ECDIS, and conning GUIs
[/list]

notes.title: SP1 Hotfix 1
notes.content:
This micro update fixes the issue where the ship's right throttle / thruster did not work. The right engine was broken in SP1; we apologize for our oversight. 

The right engine and its respective throttle / thruster is now functioning properly. 

Once again, we apologize for our error in the previous update.

[*] Camera panning with right click now locks the cursor so it disappears when panning and returns it to the centre of the game window when right click is released.
[/list]

notes.title: New Environment & Radar Feature Update
notes.content:
[h2][u][b]Radar feature update:[/b][/u][/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a new feature: NORTH UP mode! 
[*] North Up is a feature we've had requested for a while, and we are so excited to finally bring this feature to you today.
[*] Re-worked major areas of the radar to ensure stability. 
[/list]

[h2][u][b]New Environment:[/b][/u][/h2]
[list]
[*] Added Horseshoe Bay, Bowen Island, and Langdale 
[*] These are actual ferry service routes from Vancouver, Canada (Horseshoe Bay) to the two islands that ferries service on a daily basis. 
[*] A full route map can be seen in this screenshot:

notes.title: Radar Improvements & Tug Model Update
notes.content:
NEW:
 - updated radar to finish implementation on TRUE vectors
 - the radar can be set on either REL or TRUE vector modes

IMPROVED:
 - brand new tug model to replace the existing tug's exterior and interior model
 - conning display now uses degrees for rudder angle
 - conning display now says COG instead of HDG for heading

notes.title: Radar New Features & Ship Dynamics Improvement
notes.content:
New:
 - added two sets of Electronic Bearing Line (EBL) to the radar to enhance navigation features

Improved:
 - adjusted bulk carrier's ship dynamics so the ship feels MUCH heavier and more like a ship its size
 - removed bulk carrier's window tint for transparent windows (for better navigation)

notes.title: Modding Update
notes.content:
We have just released version 2.5 of BridgeTeam! This update brings a very anticipated update: the ability to import your own ship models into the simulator. 

While we are still creating more ship models and environments for future updates, we are also opening the platform up for you, the player, to import your own models into the game and configure its ship dynamics. 

This update also includes a new proprietary Ship Editor. For the ship's 3D model authors, the author can now run the Ship Editor to encrypt the model with AES-512 bit encryption. 

This will produce 2 files:
 - ship.obj.aes
 - ship.mtl.aes

This provides a solid copyright protection for the author, and the author can distribute his/her ship model knowing it is well protected from copyright / theft. 

BridgeTeam Ship Simulator reads directly from these encrypted formats. 

We have a modding guide in a .pdf format, available on our Discord. Feel free to join us for more details on how to create mods! 

We look forward to seeing your screenshots of your mods / imported ship models!
